issues.description: Identifier naming inconsistency: the QFT method expected by the exercise is named qft_circuit(qc: QuantumCircuit). In the template (template_repository/ex1_qft.py) the scaffold defines _qft_circuit(self, qc: QuantumCircuit) (leading underscore). In the solution (solution_repository/ex1_qft.py) the implemented method is qft_circuit(self, qc: QuantumCircuit) and qft_circuit_inverse calls self.qft_circuit(...). This mismatch between _qft_circuit and qft_circuit will confuse students about which method to implement and can break automated tests or any code that calls qft_circuit (the name used in the problem statement task).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the QFT method name consistent across artifacts. Recommended: rename the template method _qft_circuit(...) to qft_circuit(...) so the template, solution, and problem statement all use the same identifier. Alternatively, change qft_circuit_inverse in the template to call self._qft_circuit(...) and update the problem statement/task name to match, but the preferred fix is renaming the template method to qft_circuit to match the task and solution.

issues.description: The 3-qubit forward QFT function is named inconsistently across artifacts. In the template (ex1_qft.py) the forward QFT stub is declared as _qft_circuit(qc: QuantumCircuit) (leading underscore), while the solution implements qft_circuit(qc: QuantumCircuit) (no underscore). The problem statement refers to the Exercise 6.1 QFT task but does not prescribe a specific function name, so students mapping the exercise to the starter code or comparing to the reference implementation may be confused which identifier to implement or test against.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the forward QFT method name consistent. Preferred fix: rename the template method from _qft_circuit(...) to qft_circuit(...) (remove the leading underscore) so the template and solution use the same identifier. Alternatively, rename the solution method to _qft_circuit(...) and update any tests/docs to match; however, aligning the template to qft_circuit is recommended to avoid suggesting a private helper name and to match the reference implementation.
